summary: Container apps in the one-click installer: Ghost, Nextcloud, Uptime Kuma, n8n, Gitea, Plausible and Jellyfin, on private networks with loopback-only ports via guarded agent verbs (KD-040). App backup and restore with in-container database dumps; S3 provider presets with a live test (KD-043). App health alerts (KD-042), OS package updates and an in-panel update notice (KD-041). Migrations 0010-0012 are additive: app_port, app health tables, restore_points.manifest. Backups now work on real hosts with no manual step: the job worker writes the restic password and destination credentials to the agent through a new write-only verb, backup.secret_put (KD-044). No migration: stored refs (backup_schedule:<id>) are mapped to an agent-safe name at the agent boundary, and schedules without a password get one generated on first use. Needs the agent from this release; older agents fail backups with an upgrade message. SFTP destinations are refused with a clear error until SSH keys are provisioned.
